complete_examples.text: Therefore, the nonlinear behaviour was assumed to concentrate at the base of the pier and was modelled by a plastic hinge-like nonlinear rotational spring.
The second part is the rigid displacement caused by rotation formation resulting from plastic hinge rotation at the side support beam-column joint - denoted by Δy2.
Based on plastic hinge model, the CAA resistance can be simulated by Eq. (27) and the deflection value (Δcaa) predicted by Eq. (31).
